item.title: SCP-094:
item.content:encoded:
This is too simple and played far too straight for me to really enjoy it. I can think of two black hole SCPs in Series 1 alone that blow this one out of the water in terms of creativity and sink-teeth-into-ness, let alone the rest of the site. This is sorely in need of some meat on its bones.

item.title: SCP-5290:
item.content:encoded:
I kinda like this one, it's reasonably quick, and while the anomaly involved isn't the most unique, it's definitely an interesting take on the "multiple timelines" trope.
However I think I'm gonna have to leave this as a no-vote for the time being, as I can't actually read what I feel is a significant portion of of the article due to the fact that Flash is no longer being supported on most browsers. I understand that this is no fault of yours, and I understand if you can't actually do anything about changing that portion to be available again, but I can't help but feel like I'm missing out on something rather important.

item.title: SCP-597: Re: Hmm
item.content:encoded:
Headcanon explanation of two possible differences which the Foundation tried (unsuccessfully) to exploit…

  • Lactating mammals (of any gender; natural vs. induced lactation irrelevant): Instead of the suckling compulsion and/or arousal, lactating mammals within sight of SCP-597 feel more and more uneasy; this culminates in either jealous rage (50%), paranoid protection of offspring (if they exist — 35%), or a sense of hopeless inferiority (akin to postpartum depression — 15%). Childless subjects lactating artificially may experience hallucinations and delusions related to nursing a "phantom" infabt.
  • Sex-repulsed asexuals (of any gender): Instead of the suckling compulsion and/or arousal, sex-repulsed asexuals within sight of SCP-597 feel more and more uneasy; this culminates in either anorexia (with a particular dislike of dairy products — 35%), body-image dysphoria (a desire to remove their own "offending" parts — 15%), or violent loathing of SCP-597 ("Kill it with fire!" — 50%)

Foundation personnel who are known to be pregnant or nursing, or who self-identify as asexual, may request transferral to a different Foundation site without penalty, after undergoing suitable medical and psychiatric evaluation.

item.title: Being Alone:
item.content:encoded: The thing is, though, he got “damn near everything” he wanted at the Foundation, because he was, y’know, a Gary Stu. If you’re working on another interpretation of Duke where he used to a dramatic but not necessarily despicable individual before the Foundation confined him, that’d be neat to see, provided that you intend to show us the cause of the transformation.

item.title: SCP-5870: Re: -1
item.content:encoded:
I now fully understand your points, and I will keep in mind, particularly the fact that I need to improve the tone of my writing style. I apologize if I sounded rude a little, but at several points, I was just confused by some of what you have said.

Hopefully, I rectify in future articles the writing issues you pointed out, because now that I think about it, professional tone is a problem for me. I will also try to make the anomalous part clearer :)
